Preserve the low-overhead direct path for trivial/self-contained requests while requiring PROTOCOL and the total-value overlay for nontrivial optimization/choice, without loading mutable owners unless facts require them.

role_dispositions.destination: Self-contained direct mode skips owner/current-state orchestration, but no longer skips the lean reasoning layer when the task itself is nontrivial/consequential.
In direct mode, nontrivial decision/design/diagnosis/planning/optimization still reads PROTOCOL.md.
